scripts.secretlint: node --input-type=module -e "import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'; import {runSecretLint} from 'secretlint'; const files=execFileSync('git',['ls-files','-z'],{encoding:'utf8'}).split('\0').filter(p=>p&&!p.split('/').includes('node_modules')&&p!=='main.js'); const r=await runSecretLint({cliOptions:{cwd:process.cwd(),filePathOrGlobList:files,noGlob:true},engineOptions:{formatter:'stylish',color:false,maskSecrets:true}}); if(r.stdout) console.log(r.stdout); if(r.stderr) console.error(r.stderr); process.exitCode=r.exitStatus;"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run knip && npm run secretlint && npm run skills && npm test
